paper_title: Joint Detection of Fraud and Concept Drift inOnline Conversations with   LLM-Assisted Judgment
caption: A runtime comparison between our ensemble model and various LLM models on the SEconvo dataset
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," compares the runtime performance of "Our Joint Framework" against several large language models (LLMs) on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400, while the horizontal axis lists the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." A legend indicates that the green bar corresponds to "Our Joint Framework" and the light blue bars represent the LLM models. The chart shows that "Our Joint Framework" has a runtime of 77 seconds. In contrast, the LLM models have significantly higher runtimes: "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 243 seconds. The data demonstrates that "Our Joint Framework" is substantially faster than all the compared LLM models in this streaming environment.
